title: 79. Implement insertion sort
description: Write a Python program to implement insertion sort.

template_code.python:
nums = list(map(int, input("Enter numbers (space-separated): ").split()))
for i in range(1, len(nums)):
    key = nums[i]
    j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 and nums[j] > key:
        nums[j + 1] = nums[j]
        j -= 1
    nums[j + 1] = key
print("Insertion Sorted:", nums)

errors = []
if len(password) < 8:

if not re.search(r"[A-Z]", password):

if not re.search(r"[a-z]", password):
    errors.append("  - At least one lowercase letter required")

if not re.search(r"[!@#$%^&*(),.?\":{}|<>]", password):

if errors:
    print("Password is WEAK. Issues:")
    for e in errors:
